item.title: Tehran, Tashkent agree to expand long-term agricultural cooperation: Uzbekistan
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Uzbekistan and Iran have agreed to expand long-term cooperation in agriculture, pursue joint projects and strengthen ties between economic and business representatives, Uzbekistan’s Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources announced.

item.title: Minab school bombing targeted foundations of morality, humanity: Judiciary spokesperson
item.description: Bandar Abbas, IRNA – Judiciary spokesperson Ali Kazemi has condemned the US-Israeli bombing of Shajareh Tayyebeh School in Minab, southern Iran, describing it as more than a military crime and saying it targeted the foundations of morality and humanity in the international community.

item.title: Enemy repeated Ba’athists’ miscalculation: Amoli Larijani
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Chairman of Iran’s Expediency Council Ayatollah Sadeq Amoli Larijani says the United States and Israeli regime repeated the same “miscalculation” made by former Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein and his supporters by believing that military action against Iran would quickly achieve their objectives.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86271269/Enemy-repeated-Ba-athists-miscalculation-Amoli-Larijani

Tehran, IRNA – Chairman of Iran’s Expediency Council Ayatollah Sadeq Amoli Larijani says the United States and Israeli regime repeated the same “miscalculation” made by former Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein and his supporters by believing that military action against Iran would quickly achieve their objectives.

item.title: High time for washington to break free from Israeli shackles: Iranian FM
item.description: Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has said, “It is time for Washington to break free from these shackles,” responding to an article in Israel Hayom arguing that US policy should require Washington to bear a cost for any perceived disrespect or attack against Israel.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/photo/86271211/High-time-for-washington-to-break-free-from-Israeli-shackles

Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has said, “It is time for Washington to break free from these shackles,” responding to an article in Israel Hayom arguing that US policy should require Washington to bear a cost for any perceived disrespect or attack against Israel.

item.title: Mourning flag raised over holy shrine of Hazrat Masoumeh (SA)
item.description: A ceremony to replace the flag on the dome of the holy shrine of Hazrat Fatemeh Masoumeh (SA) was held in the city of Qom on September 20, 2026, coinciding with the approaching anniversary of her martyrdom. A large number of pilgrims and shrine keepers attended the event.
